newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak paper mill SCP to issue SKK 1.0 bln bonds.
newsitem.headline: Slovak paper mill SCP to issue SKK 1.0 bln bonds.

text.p: Slovakia's largest paper and cellulose producer SCP Ruzomberok a.s. on Thursday said it would launch a domestic bond issue totalling one billion crowns in the first quarter of this year.
SCP's financial director Lubomir Klinko told Reuters that the issue would be lead managed by Slovenska Sporitelna a.s..
"At present, we are completing work on the bond issue, so that detailed information should be available in the near future," Klinko said.
Funds from the issue will help cover part of the SCP's investment plans of around 2.5 billion for years 1997 and 1998.
SCP is majority-owned by a private group ECO-Invest s.r.o. Zvolen, after it bought 67 percent from the Slovak National Property Fund (NPF), the state privatisation agency, last September.
The NPF still holds the remaining 33 percent in SCP.

The company posted a net profit of around 480 million crowns in the first three quarters of last year, and expected a full 1996 after-tax profit of about 730 million crowns. -- Peter Laca, Bratislava Newsroom, 42-7-563-3687
